Course Description:
Managing personal finances and wealth is the key for the successful and stress life of an
individual. This course helps the students to make informed financial decisions in their
life by reducing the risk of ending in financial turmoil. This course aims to provide a
strong foundation for managing personal finance and wealth of students through real-
world applications, case studies, and interactive activities. Students will develop the
knowledge and confidence to achieve financial stability and growth.
Learning Objectives:
Students will develop practical skills in budgeting, saving, and investing, while also
gaining an understanding of credit management, tax planning, and retirement
strategies. By exploring various financial instruments available and equip them to
optimize their wealth-building efforts and achieve financial security. The course also
emphasizes the importance of risk management, financial psychology, and consumer
protection, ensuring that students can navigate financial challenges with confidence.
Ultimately, the course aims to cultivate responsible financial habits and long-term
wealth management strategies for a secure and prosperous future.

Learning Outcomes:

After completing this course, the participants should be able to:
1) Students will be able to learn how to prepare and manage the personal budget viz.,
expenses, savings effectively.
2) Students will get an overview of investment options available to build their wealth.
3) Students will learn how to plan financially for their higher education, home loan,
retirement, health and Insurance.
4) Students learn on assessing financial risks, recognize fraudulent schemes, and build
strategies for secures future.
